account: GrantRail presents a portfolio concept for education philanthropy built with Airtable Omni. It demonstrates natural-language interactions for adding grantees, examining demand ratios, identifying sustainability risks, and updating milestones. The site says that its dashboards use synthetic data and do not report a live portfolio. Consequently, the displayed student counts, funding totals, return ratios, and demand changes cannot establish a benefit. The proposed contribution is decision support for education funders. In a Substack post of 24 March 2026, the author of The Tabula Report states that GrantRail is the author's own build and that it runs three agents for portfolio tracking, alternative school models and state legislation. The author reports that one prompt produced a West Virginia report for microschool founders in four minutes. The author compares that with a consultant report that would cost $10,000 to $15,000 and take weeks to produce. The author asserts this comparison and does not measure it. No source verifies an improvement in how funds are allocated or a measured time saving. No source names a funder or educator who has used the tool.
